name: fig_proof_stats
title: Size of the trusted Lean core and its axiom footprint
question: How large is the trusted Lean core, where do its theorems live, and which logical axioms do the audited theorems rely on?
model: Counts. (a,b) source lines and top-level def/inductive/structure/abbrev/instance and theorem keywords per file (regex over lean/CryoLean/*.lean); (c) #print axioms of the 44 audited theorems; (d) declarations in the elaborated environment (including auto-generated constructors and instances).
data: (a,b) lean/CryoLean/*.lean recounted at run time with the E8 rules of paper_eval.py (differences from paper/data/e8_proofs.json recorded in the data file); lean/audit-axioms.json; docs/forensics/cryolean-forensics.json and summary.json. Data: paper/data/fig_proof_stats.json.
caption: (a,b) The trusted core is 2,580 lines of Lean 4 in 9 files; 98 of the 110 source theorems are in Soundness.lean. (c) All 44 audited theorems rely only on Lean's standard axioms; 24 need only propext and 5 use Classical.choice. (d) The forensics extractor sees 839 elaborated declarations, including all 110 source theorems and 166 theorems generated by the elaborator (sizeOf_spec, inj, injEq, ...), with no non-standard axiom, statement smell or unsafe flag. Audit and forensics axiom sets agree for 44/44 audited theorems.
